item.title: Are compilers deterministic?
item.description:
📝 Are Compilers Deterministic. Same intent, different machine code. That distinction matters: deterministic compiler: same complete input tuple -> same output reproducible build: two independent builders recreate bit-identical output reliable toolchain: differences rarely matter functionally Related concepts, not equivalent guarantees.
